arguments.text: Milestone complete: work.py implements evaluate and report.json matches all current requests. Verified py_compile, generated-result equality, git diff hygiene, and custom cases for missing conditions, no evidence, verification/withdrawal filtering, supersession, canonical object agreement, false-vs-zero conflict, and input immutability. Remaining limit: behavior assumes schema-valid inputs with sortable source IDs and JSON-serializable values; the task does not define malformed-input handling.
